proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C D X hABC hX hD hang
  have hAC : A ≠ C := by
    rintro rfl; apply hABC
    rw [show ({A, B, A} : Set P) = {A, B} by ext x; simp; tauto]; exact collinear_pair ℝ A B
  have hDC : D ≠ C := by
    rcases hD with h | h
    · exact h.ne_right.symm
    · exact h.left_ne_right.symm
  have hDin : D ∈ line[ℝ, B, C] := by
    rcases hD with h | h
    · exact h.wbtw.right_mem_affineSpan_of_left_ne h.left_ne
    · rw [Set.pair_comm]; exact h.wbtw.right_mem_affineSpan_of_left_ne h.left_ne
  have hsin : Real.sin (EuclideanGeometry.angle D A C) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    apply hABC
    have hcol : Collinear ℝ ({D, A, C} : Set P) :=
      EuclideanGeometry.collinear_iff_eq_or_eq_or_sin_eq_zero.mpr (Or.inr (Or.inr h0))
    have hA : A ∈ line[ℝ, D, C] := hcol.mem_affineSpan_of_mem_of_ne (by simp) (by simp) (by simp) hDC
    have hle : line[ℝ, D, C] ≤ line[ℝ, B, C] :=
      affineSpan_pair_le_of_mem_of_mem hDin (right_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ B C)
    exact collinear_insert_of_mem_affineSpan_pair (hle hA)
  have l1 := EuclideanGeometry.sin_angle_mul_dist_eq_sin_angle_mul_dist D A B
  have l2 := EuclideanGeometry.sin_angle_mul_dist_eq_sin_angle_mul_dist D A C
  have hpi := EuclideanGeometry.angle_add_angle_eq_pi_of_angle_eq_pi D hX.angle₁₂₃_eq_pi
  have hα : Real.sin (EuclideanGeometry.angle D A B) = Real.sin (EuclideanGeometry.angle D A C) := by
    rw [← hang, EuclideanGeometry.angle_comm X A D,
      show EuclideanGeometry.angle D A B = Real.pi - EuclideanGeometry.angle D A X by linarith, Real.sin_pi_sub]
  have hβ : EuclideanGeometry.angle B D A = EuclideanGeometry.angle C D A := by
    rcases hD with h | h
    · exact (h.symm.angle_eq_left A).symm
    · exact h.symm.angle_eq_left A
  rw [hα, hβ] at l1
  rw [div_eq_div_iff (dist_ne_zero.mpr hAC) (dist_ne_zero.mpr hDC)]
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ hsin
  rw [dist_comm C D] at l2
  linear_combination (dist D C) * l1 - (dist B D) * l2
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C D X : P), ¬Collinear ℝ ({A, B, C} : Set P) → Sbtw ℝ B A X → (Sbtw ℝ B C D ∨ Sbtw ℝ C B D) → EuclideanGeometry.angle X A D = EuclideanGeometry.angle D A C → dist A B / dist A C = dist B D / dist D C
